title: How to Change Search Results Sorting Options
text:
## How to Change Search Results Sorting Options
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000024824
Navigate to MY CONTENT > EDIT POST SETTINGS and click on " Edit " for the post type in which the sorting order will be changed:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127318949/original/ERDYTOtTkiG3rq5oOXTGbjXWwJImC6bomg.png?1687449815 | alt: ]
Move to the Search Results Design tab:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12096869764/original/IhII1wbRo1vwfaI88rcjaZgIm_0jHOjy5w.png?1629029649 | alt: ]
Scroll down and expand the Additional Settings and open up the " Order Results By ":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12146908052/original/kQ9uHNsHvIadZc5p5T5pSvfbe7lCgyWs0w.png?1721923515 | alt: ]

## Sort Order Options
Customizing the sort order for member and post type search results can be found in the Post Settings in the admin dashboard. The available sorting options depend on whether the results are listings/profiles or member-published posts.

## Member Listings
Member Name A-Z
Member Name Z-A
Member/Post ID (Oldest First)
Member/Post ID (Newest First)
Sort by Last Name A-Z (If no last name is present, it will use the company name as the last name)
Sort by Last Name Z-A (If no last name is present, it will use the company name as the last name)
Number of Reviews
Random Order *

## Member Posts
Date Posted (Earliest Date Last)
Date Posted (Earliest Date First)
Start Date (Earliest Date Last) - If Applicable
Start Date (Earliest Date First) - If Applicable
End Date (Earliest Date Last) - If Applicable
End Date (Earliest Date First) - If Applicable
Post ID (Smallest to Largest)
Post ID (Largest to Smallest)
Post Title A - Z
Post Title Z - A
Advanced - Edit in Search Widget
Random Order *

## Selecting Random Order
When the order is set to " Random ", the results will be randomized once and then maintained for all pages of results for that search. Viewing results pages 2, 3, 4, etc of the search will not show newly randomized results - the order will be maintained on all of these pages of results, even when navigating back and forth between them. Once a new search is performed or the user navigates back to the original page of results, the order will be freshly randomized again.
The Random option will apply to all types of searches except radius-based location searches, which always order by distance from the searched location.
Searching by category, keyword or nothing will have random results.

## Membership Plan “Search Priority”
Additionally, the setting "When Sorting Members - Respect Membership Plan “Search Priority” will respect the "Search Results Priority" logic based on the Membership Plan settings.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12122712703/original/u36NJdquMwu9bNvkmvScp3BFYtwvJAEVWg.png?1678980780 | alt: ]

## Location Searches & Sort Order
When doing a radius-type location search (cities and zip codes by default) it will return members in order of distance from the searched location.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12159093712/original/BTXUyp4Z5L8O0DJLAKLqqyzMkCtjaRKXGQ.png?1743186241 | alt: ]
Selecting any of the front-end options will override the distance and results will be returned based on the chosen filter:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12159093875/original/tNe_RijaRRfZnrQJEJnvkTpQb-rl32Dyeg.png?1743186300 | alt: ]

## Search Results Sort Order Options
Whenever a search is conducted, the results are automatically filtered and sorted according to the selected option. Additionally, members and visitors can choose their preferred sorting option directly from the front end of the website.
There are 6 available filters on the front end:
Sort Results
Sort by Most Reviews
Sort by Name A-Z
Sort by Name Z-A
Sort By Last Name A-Z
Sort By Last Name Z-A
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12158961058/original/q0FI3Okl87tJg9agnIl8m0UhdannhyqylA.png?1743010978 | alt: ]

## Sort Order Text Labels
If the admin does not want one of the available sort options to show on the front end, the corresponding Text Label needs to be left blank by deleting the text:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12098050463/original/wfD_nuytmbdupWdBEFBBMXkzZwE_J3217w.png?1631305115 | alt: ]
These are the text labels that can be edited or deleted:
Label Name: Default sort label
System Variable: default_sort_label
Label Name: Most reviews sort label
System Variable: most_reviews_sort_label
Label Name: Az sort label
System Variable: az_sort_label
Label Name: Za sort label
System Variable: za_sort_label
Please refer to this article to learn more about text labels: Settings » Text Labels In this example, after deleting the text labels for " Sort by Name/Last Name ", these options no longer shows in the front end of the site:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090361492/original/iE71qWCCrnVxHB8LIzzyeBAUbdGJZDVrZg.png?1616498591 | alt: ]

## Important Note
At this time, the ability to compare members in search results on the front end is not available.
